mission.title: Beret
mission.description: Hunt for a way to reach the General through his commandos and the computer systems they use.

npc.say: Eh, what are you standing about for, bete? You must go find him!
Control, we have a security breach in progress!

phase.briefing:
The Merovingian has finally realized that the neighborhood Exiles are quite incapable of getting their hands on something as important as a kill code for the Oracle.
He has a new plan to reveal to you. This one is much more promising, in my opinion.

enter.say: A new plan... We put rat poison in her cookie dough?

talk.say:
It's about time you got here. I have decided that we will approach the General about obtaining a code to kill the Oracle. Oh, I know that he declared "war" on us previously, but obviously that was all part of a scheme to put Zion off their guard. He can bear the Oracle no great love, as he has stolen her favorite companion, and, what is more, only I can give him what he needs now. Hah!
Genius, non?

complete.say: Eh, what are you standing about for, bete? You must go find him!

phase.briefing: We have had the General's helicopter flight paths charted for some time now. Since his return, his commandos have been observed disembarking at some of the landing spots. We've traced some of these to the building to which I'm sending you. Try to find out something about the General's location.

enter.say: I've got Exile programs in there. Should be commandos.
Hm, they don't sound too interested in chatting.

done.say: Well, you've run out of commandos to "question," and we're still none the wiser. Maybe Flood will have a better idea.

phase.briefing: You're not making this easy, {player}. All right... I didn't want to waste this intelligence on you, but we have observed that the commandos are accessing certain computer systems across the city. I'm sending you to one of them now. Try not to make a botch of it.

enter.say: I'm picking up Exile programs in there, and a secured computer system.

done.say: The network in there just went dead.
Seems like they killed their network just before you got to that terminal. They're hiding something, but just knowing that doesn't get us any closer to the General.

phase.briefing: So they heard you coming and shut everything down, did they? Lovely, {player}. And what's most galling about this is that I have no option other than to have you try it again at another system they've been accessing.

enter.say: Okay, this one is totally not our fault... That place looks completely dead. You'd better check it out all the same, I suppose, but I've got a fat lot of nothing on my screen.

done.say: Yeah, that's pretty much what I thought. That place is wiped clean. Whatever they were doing there, they got out way before we showed up.

near.say: Control, we have a security breach in progress!

mission.finish: It seems that the General is so far pleased to ignore our overtures, although I'm sure a good deal of that is due to your bumbling about. And I don't want to hear your ridiculous excuses about night-vision troops popping out of thin air! We've checked your operator's record of the code stream, and it showed no activity in there, aside from you. Really, you should be ashamed of yourself...
